Chapter 6377: Why?

Chapter 6377: Why?

It is time - the words carried a supreme will leaving no room for resistance.

“Pop!” Ten-realm Emperor covered in a blood serum evaporated into a mist.

“Ahh!” A scream echoed but it didn’t come from the emperor but rather, the lake itself.

At this moment, everyone felt it was alive. The scream encompassed the laments of countless entities.

They knew he was dead from the execution. Not a single sliver of life remained so how could he scream? Was the rebirth successful or was it just the lake screaming?

Did it turn into a fiend after generations of sanguine accumulation? Everyone felt a chill coursing down their spine as if something dreadful was crawling on them.

“No!!!” Tenth-gen Chen screamed but couldn’t change the situation.

The corpse of Ten-realm Emperor dissipated into mist and the life force of the lake could no longer revive him.

Silence took over; no one dared to breathe loudly. The thirteenth peak was back and the supreme ancestor was there. Unfortunately, none of them was qualified to see him. Just his words alone put an end to the battle.

Regular disciples became equal to emperors and desolate gods. There was no difference between classifications since all were below the supreme ancestor.

In fact, not everyone was qualified to kneel before him. The supreme ancestor resembled an immortal. Being able to see him was the greatest honor.

“Why, why…” Tenth-gen Chen’s complexion changed continuously with rage.

Since he was on the return path, his aura swept through Desolate Frontier. Everyone could sense his hatred.

“Why?!” He roared: “Ten-realm deserved death for being disrespectful, but we traded our lives for his, what crime was committed?! Why must you push us off the cliff? We have contributed and died for Desolate Frontier, this is unacceptable!”

His thunderous voice crushed one peak after another despite the defensive momentum.

Disciples exchanged glances and some agreed with him. The Chen had certainly contributed to the sect, hence their four badges.

However, they couldn’t deny the sin regarding the sacrifices. This outweighed their contribution, hence the supreme ancestor’s decision.

“Desolate Ancestor had given you a chance but stupidity got the best of you. Now, the Chen will cease to exist.” Li Qiye responded.

“We are the only ones who can decide whether we live or die, not even the high heaven!” Tenth-gen Chen roared and his eyes turned blood red in a frenzy.

“Looks like you think you are indestructible with your devious art, daring to talk about the high heaven.” Li Qiye said.

Some sighed after hearing this. The Chen simply wouldn’t repent; no one could change the ancestor’s mind now. In reality, they had several chances to survive ever since his return.

“I want to see how you will end my branch!” Tenth-gen Chen gave in to madness. His bright red eyes could be seen in the dark.

As he stood in the middle of the blood lake, he looked like a devil being born there.

“Boom!” The lake resonated with him, resulting in a bright eruption
